title: Podaci za AI: privatnost i trovanje podataka
summary: Lični podaci u treniranju, promptovima i logovima (GDPR, ZZPL), upravljanje skupovima podataka (data card, snapshot, lineage, EU AI Act čl. 10) i odbrana od trovanja podataka po NIST AI 100-2.
title_en: Data for AI: privacy and data poisoning
summary_en: Personal data in training, prompts and logs (GDPR, Serbian ZZPL), dataset governance (data card, snapshot, lineage, EU AI Act Art. 10) and defense against data poisoning per NIST AI 100-2.
